column1: # Manifest for the committed real-world parse-regression corpus in ./fixtures/.
# The fixtures themselves are checked in (see ./fixtures/) and parsed by the
# Rust integration test. Each fixture must parse without ERROR or MISSING
# nodes. Each fixture has a sibling <filename>.LICENSE recording its upstream
# project and license; the files remain under those licenses (see ./README.md).
# Add new cases by dropping the file in ./fixtures/, adding a .LICENSE sibling,
# Added from the broader stress-test sweep (see commit history).
# npocmaka/batch.scripts (MIT) — a torture-test collection of cmd idioms;
# included to guard the trickier edge cases (carets, (echo(), @@, delayed exp).
# Original Minimal Reproducible Examples (authored here, MIT) that distill
# idioms from scripts whose licenses prevent vendoring them verbatim.
# Edge-case guards added on the cmd-edge-cases branch: caret-escaped
# expansions, sigil-led command names, and spaced SET names.
